biocs.name: Uncommon SQL-like Command Line Pattern
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell processes with command lines containing SQL-like syntax patterns
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

xql_queries.name: Detect SQL-like PowerShell Commands
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_command_line
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
